facility_prologue.name: The Morning Collection
facility_prologue.description: Standard reclamation procedure for D-Class subjects within the modern residential sector.

events.message: The silence of the corridor is broken by the faint, rhythmic hiss of hydraulic boots. A calm, synthesized voice echoes through the dormitory speakers: 'Inmate D-902, please prepare for scheduled biometric verification.'

The seamless white blast door slides open with a whisper. Two Security Enforcers in high-gloss tactical white armor enter. One takes a position at the front, the other stands directly behind you, boxing you in. 'D-902, step into the spotlight. You are required at Testing Sector 4. Non-compliance will result in immediate neurological damping.'

options.text: Stand up and follow the enforcers into the corridor.
options.log: D-902 complied. Proceeding to Testing Sector 4 under guard escort.

options.text: Refuse to move, eyeing the gaps in their white armor.
options.log: D-902 resisted. Compliance enforced via non-lethal shock baton. Subject is being dragged to Sector 4.

options.text: Ask what kind of 'testing' is scheduled today.
options.log: D-902 questioned the procedure. Request ignored; subject moved to corridor for Sector 4 transport.

events.message: The overhead lights flicker violently. The hum of the facility's power core pitch-shifts into a low, ominous groan. 'Main power failing... backup generators... [REDACTED]'.
Total darkness. Then, the backup red emergency lights pulse. A roar echoes from the end of the hall. Your escorting guards freeze, looking at each other in terror. This is your chance.

options.text: Bolt into the darkness of a side hallway.
options.log: D-902 escaped into the maintenance shafts during the initial blackout.

options.text: Lunge for a panicked guard's sidearm.
options.log: D-902 attempted to disarm security. A struggle ensued.

options.text: Stay close to the guards and wait for orders.
options.log: D-902 remained stationary, showing absolute submission to authority.

the_infiltrator.name: Chapter 3: The Infiltrator's Path
the_infiltrator.description: A hidden voice in the dark. Allegiances are tested.

events.message: A discarded guard radio on the floor crackles to life. '...902... do you copy? This is Delta-4. We are opening the maintenance doors in your sector. Move now if you want to live.'

You find a dead-drop in a locker. A burner phone and a Level 3 Keycard. A text message appears: 'The Foundation treats you like cattle. We offer a way out. Deliver SCP-035 to the surface, and you are a free man. Do we have a deal?'

options.text: Accept the phone and the mission.
options.log: D-902 has defected. Recruitment by Chaos Insurgency successful.

options.text: Destroy the phone. I won't be a pawn for anyone.
options.log: D-902 rejected the Insurgency's offer, choosing a path of isolated survival.

events.message: The red lights flicker out completely. In the total silence, you hear a sound like grinding stone. You turn your flashlight toward the corner. SCP-173 is there. It hasn't moved yet. You need to blink.

options.text: Keep your eyes wide open, ignoring the burning sting.
options.log: D-902 engaged in a desperate stare-down with SCP-173. Physical exhaustion imminent.

options.text: Back away while maintaining eye contact, reaching for the door handle.
options.log: D-902 attempted a controlled retreat from SCP-173.

options.text: Blink and bolt for the opposite exit.
options.log: D-902 blinked. SCP-173 moved with lethal speed, nearly snapping their neck.
